is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (s.l.), including An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., and An. arabiensis (Page 3, Methods and Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes kdr-west (Vgsc L995F), kdr-east (Vgsc L995S), and ace-1 (Ace-1 G280S) (Page 3, 6, 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (Page 7) and Table 3 (Page 7) provide genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and the number of mosquitoes tested for each marker across multiple sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae and pupae from field habitats in sixteen sites across Niger in 2019 and 2020 (Page 4, Study sites).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting original insecticide resistance monitoring data and the first report of kdr-east in Niger (Page 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is reported for 16 specific localities including Agadez, Balleyara, Boboye, Gaya, Guidimouni, Keita, Madaoua, Madarounfa, Magaria, Matamey, Niamey V, Say, Tchintabaraden, Tessaoua, Tillabery, and Zindarou (Table 2 and 3, Page 7).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted in 2019 and 2020 (Page 4, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study is part of the PMI VectorLink project (Page 1), which conducts routine surveillance, but this appears to be the primary research publication of these specific 2019-2020 results.

supplement.evidence: While a supplementary dataset is mentioned (Page 15), the essential genotype counts and sample sizes for the markers are fully provided in Tables 2 and 3 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study reports on countrywide insecticide resistance monitoring in Niger during 2019 and 2020. It provides detailed genotype counts for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w), Vgsc L995S (kdr-e), and Ace-1 G280S across 16 sites. It also includes extensive bioassay data (WHO tube and CDC bottle) for pyrethroids, chlorfenapyr, and PBO synergism. This is the first report of the kdr-east mutation in Niger.
